name: flowviz
description: IPAI – Interpretable Planning for AI: animated, abstract flow diagrams that an LLM can generate from a JSON spec

scripts.build:examples: node bin/flowviz.mjs build examples/chat-rabbitmq.flow.json -o out/chat-rabbitmq.html && node bin/flowviz.mjs build examples/k8s-bugfix.flow.json -o out/k8s-bugfix.html && node bin/flowviz.mjs build examples/sidebar-demo.flow.json -o out/sidebar-demo.html && node bin/flowviz.mjs build examples/chat-demo.flow.json -o out/chat-demo.html && node bin/flowviz.mjs build examples/signup-demo.flow.json -o out/signup-demo.html
